remarks: Welcome to the quiet and beautifully maintained grounds of the highly sought after Foxboro complex featuring this remodeled condo! Main floor invites you to the gourmet eat-in kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances to accommodate your inner chef. Living room with wood burning fireplace and vaulted ceiling is perfect for gathering friends and family. The dining area with slider to privacy deck compliments this home. Primary bedroom with ceiling fan, walk-in closet and meticulously designed bath with separate tub and shower and double sink vanity offer the perfect retreat. Second bedroom is substantial in size and adjacent to a full bath. Carpeted stairs lead you to a sanctuary loft space with skylights, perfect for an office, play area, or even an additional bedroom. Plenty of closets and gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Lower level offers added space for storage or home gym and leads to a one car garage. Stackable washer and dryer are conveniently located on the main floor! This complex provides plenty of parking, pool, expansive grounds for walking and is convenient to shopping, I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.
